The petitioners have approached this Court aggrieved by Exts.P16 and P17 stop memos issued to them preventing them from carrying on their business operations. In Exts.P16 and P17 stop memos, it is seen that the respondent Panchayat has, based on the objections received from members of the public, alleged that there are violations of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act that has been occasioned by the petitioners. The case of the petitioners is that there is no such violation as alleged against them and they can establish this before the respondent Panchayat.
